title: WorkerPollRequest
description: The body of the POST a worker sends to poll_url. Who is asking and what it could lend. All eight keys are always present. It carries no address, token, config or job history. A poll is only sent when the worker has a free slot and is not draining, so free_slots is never 0. additionalProperties is false because that is what this version sends; the body grew in v0.2.0, so a production endpoint should read the keys it knows and ignore the rest.

worker.description: worker_name from the machine's config. Default: its hostname. A claim by the machine, not proof of identity; the bearer token is what identifies it.

os.description: worker_os from the config. Default: the OS the binary was built for ('linux'). The Windows install writes 'windows'.

arch.description: CPU architecture of the binary, as Rust names it: x86_64, aarch64.

version.description: Version of the runner, such as 0.2.4.

max_slots.description: Containers this machine runs at once.

free_slots.description: Slots free when the poll was sent. One task is taken per poll, whatever this says.

cpus.description: CPUs the process sees; on Windows, those of the WSL2 VM. null when unknown.

memory_bytes.description: MemTotal the process sees; on Windows, that of the WSL2 VM. null when unknown.
